description: Utility functions and type definitions for document editing features in a Slate-based editor, including formatting, node movement, insertion, and content navigation.

methods.name: isElementActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific element type is active in the editor.

methods.name: clearFormatting
methods.description: Removes heading, blockquote, code nodes and all mark styles from the selected text in the editor.

methods.name: moveChildren
methods.description: Moves child nodes from a parent node to a specified path, optionally filtering which nodes to move.

methods.name: insertNodesButReplaceIfSelectionIsAtEmptyParagraphOrHeading
methods.description: Inserts nodes at the current selection, replacing empty paragraph or heading nodes if present, and refocusing the editor.

methods.name: EditorAfterButIgnoringingPointsWithNoContent
methods.description: Finds the next point after a given location, ignoring points with no content.

methods.name: nodeTypeMatcher
methods.description: Creates a matcher function to identify nodes of specific types.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Throws an error if the given condition is false.
